newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Southern China's Hainan executes four for robbery.
newsitem.headline: Southern China's Hainan executes four for robbery.

text.p: China's southern Hainan province on Thursday executed four people for robbery, the semi-official China News Service said.
The Haikou Intermediate People's Court handed down the death sentences to Kan Wei, Zuo Yifeng, Luo Yongjun and Li Yi-fan.
Kan, together with accomplices, committed two robberies in 1995 and 1996, making off with a total of $3,871 in cash and some jewelry.
The other three convicts took part in a number of robberies in 1996, netting $13,466 in cash plus jewelry and a mobile phone, the report said.
China has executed more than 1,000 people in recent months under a nationwide crackdown on crime.
Executions in China are usually carried out right after sentencing.
